title: Historical performance fingerprints conflated current execution tooling with target-era campaign authorities

source_observation.environment: Exact immutable 2.5.5 archive on trusted Factorio 2.0.77 after target-era source, official-data, and scenario preflight
source_observation.fact: The current performance runner invokes the current canonical compatibility command and libraries, but both its fingerprint and compatibility invocation attempted to use paths from the immutable 2.0 worktree. That worktree intentionally predates tools/commands/compatibility/Invoke-MIRCompatAudit.ps1; its campaign also requires Factorio 2.0 rather than a hard-coded 2.1 line. Proof stopped before Factorio launch.

reproducer.expected: The fingerprint and compatibility invocation identify both the current execution-toolchain files actually invoked and the immutable target authorities consumed by the campaign, with distinct provenance scopes and the declared Factorio line.
reproducer.observed: The runner failed with 'Performance harness authority is absent: tools/commands/compatibility/Invoke-MIRCompatAudit.ps1'.

stable_id_and_migration_impact: none; execution-toolchain and target-authority provenance only
